connector.name: Sports Hub
connector.registryDescription: 41 sports API providers, 396 tools: scores, stats, odds, esports, chess, motorsport & more.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp-sports-hub. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the lacausecrypto account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: SPORTS_HUB_PROVIDERS
env.description: Comma-separated provider names or a preset (free, us-major, soccer, f1, motorsport, esports, odds, cricket, golf, chess, all). Omit to load the free preset (17 no-key providers).

env.name: THE_ODDS_API_KEY
env.description: The Odds API key (free at the-odds-api.com)
